__broaden__.ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
__broaden__.ርትዕ: ርትዕ — righteousness, uprightness (noun; subject of the 3fs verb ኀለፈት) · object of ዘእንበለ ('without uprightness')
__broaden__.ለሕይወትነ: ሕይወት — our life (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ነ '1cp our') · 'for our life', ለ- 'for' (ተቀጽቦ ለሕይወትነ 'a waiting for our life')

__broaden__.እምቃለ: ቃል — from the voice, word of (እም- + noun, construct) · 'than the voice of, more than' in comparison (ወአፍቀሩ ቃለ መሰንቆ እምቃለ መዝሙር 'they loved the voice of the lyre more than the voice of the psalm')
__broaden__.እምነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — from the kings of (እም- + plural construct 'kings of') · 'above, higher than the kings of' (ልዑለ እምነገሥተ ምድር 'high above the kings of earth')
